scope: Rath presentation and supplied overview release; numerical consistency, transform transfer, browser interaction and video playback checks.

python_tests.note: Previously verified; Python solver and fixtures are unchanged in this presentation update.

checks: 120 seeded poses and four world contacts
front, side, top and orbit cameras
CSV/JSON export and share link reload
invalid JSON and unstable geometry rejection
desktop/mobile no overflow or page errors
Rath identity, research purpose and attribution visible
simulator does not preload the overview video
overview video metadata, decoding, playback and seeking
browser.preview_transport: Local static server with HTTP byte-range support

limitations: Prescribed shoulder motion; no adaptive human gait or forward travel.
Fixed-step parity does not establish pointwise convergence of recontact force spikes.
Illustrative rath mesh does not determine physical parameters.

overview_video.title: Rath: research overview
overview_video.source: Video supplied by the project author
overview_video.role: Explanatory overview with schematic diagrams; implementation notes accompany the player. This is separate from the numerically verified Blender trajectory replay.
